title: 第1022章 魔窟之变魔种异动第1021章 指点炼丹心境再突破
content_zh:
玉简里的内容不多，但信息量极大。
楚峰看完之后，脸色逐渐凝重起来。
一个月前，驻守在极北之地的镇北军发现魔窟外面的玄冰封印忽然解开了。
那层玄冰是冰魔王当年耗费本源之力亲手封印的，非常坚硬。
镇北军时刻盯着那个地方，不敢有丝毫大意。
可现在，那玄冰封印一夜之间就消失了，仿佛从未出现过一样。
军队不敢大意，立刻派人进去探查，结果里面空荡荡的，一个活物都没有，只剩下整整齐齐的冰雕。
那些冰雕，和冰魔族的人一模一样。
身高、体型、五官，连衣服褶子都雕得清清楚楚，就好像那些冰魔族人化作的一般。
楚峰收好玉简，脑子里浮现出一道身影。
夏子瑜！
她是冰魔王的转世之身，肯定知道些什么。
但现在，她在太学院中闭关，远水解不了近渴。
“不管是什么情况，等到了那里再看看吧！”
他平复了一下心情。
几天后，带路的人已经将他带到了魔窟入口。
此刻，入口早就被镇北军围住，楚峰扫视一圈，估摸着有着近万人。
而南宫玉的分身，则在军队最前方。
他身形一闪，便来到了南宫玉身边。
“你来了。”

南宫玉分身头也没回，声音平平的。
“嗯，来了”
楚峰点了点头，然后极目看向魔窟。
造化灵力在双眼之中涌动，魔窟中的情形渐渐浮现在了他的瞳孔之中。
魔窟里确实立着不少冰雕，密密麻麻的，一直延伸到魔窟深处。
“封印是一个月前解的，我们的人进去查过，一个冰魔族都没见着，只有这些东西。”
南宫玉分身说。
“这些冰雕的位置我们没动过，原样保留，你能看出什么？”
“暂时还看不出来。”
楚峰摇了摇头，继续说道：
“师叔，我想进去看看！”
南宫玉分身似乎早料到他会这么说，点了点头：
“可以，本王随你一起去吧！”
随后，两人便化作流光进入了魔窟。
令楚峰感到惊讶的是，魔窟中竟然没有任何魔气，只有冰冷刺骨的寒气。
这种寒气比外面的要更冷，更刺骨。
content_en:
There is not much content in the jade slips, but the amount of information is huge.
After Chu Feng read it, his expression gradually became serious.
A month ago, the Zhenbei Army stationed in the far north discovered that the black ice seal outside the Demon Cave was suddenly released.
That layer of black ice was sealed by the Ice Demon King himself at the cost of his original power. It is very hard.
The Zhenbei Army kept an eye on that place and did not dare to be careless at all.
But now, the mysterious ice seal disappeared overnight, as if it had never appeared.
The army did not dare to be careless and immediately sent people to investigate. The result was that it was empty, with not a single living thing inside, only neat ice sculptures left.
Those ice sculptures are exactly the same as those of the Ice Demon Tribe.
The height, body shape, facial features, and even the pleats of the clothes are all clearly carved, as if they were transformed into those from the Ice Demon Tribe.
Chu Feng put away the jade slips and a figure appeared in his mind.
Xia Ziyu!
She is the reincarnation of the Ice Demon King, so she must know something.
But now, she is in seclusion in Taiyue College, and water from afar cannot quench her thirst for nearness.
"No matter what the situation is, wait until you get there and take a look!"
He calmed down.
A few days later, the person leading the way had brought him to the entrance of the Demon Cave.
At this moment, the entrance had long been surrounded by the Zhenbei Army. Chu Feng glanced around and estimated that there were nearly ten thousand people.
Nangong Yu's clone was at the front of the army.
He flashed and came to Nangong Yu's side.
"You're here."
Nangong Yu's clone didn't even turn his head, and his voice was calm.
"Well, here we come."
Chu Feng nodded, and then looked towards the Demon Cave.
The spiritual power of creation surged in his eyes, and the situation in the devil's cave gradually appeared in his pupils.
There are indeed many ice sculptures standing in the Demon Cave, which are densely packed and extend into the depths of the Demon Cave.
"The seal was broken a month ago. Our people went in to check and found not a single ice demon, only these things."
Nangong Yu's clone said.
"We have not touched the positions of these ice sculptures. They are kept as they are. What can you tell?"
"I can't tell yet."
Chu Feng shook his head and continued:
"Uncle Master, I want to go in and have a look!"
Nangong Yu's clone seemed to have expected that he would say this, and nodded:
"Okay, I will go with you!"
Afterwards, the two of them turned into streams of light and entered the Demon Cave.
What surprised Chu Feng was that there was no demonic energy in the demon cave, only the biting cold air.
This kind of cold air is colder and more biting than that outside.
